Decode a Contiguous PGEN Variant Range

grom_decode_pgen_range.Rd

Decode a contiguous PGEN variant range into a column-major numeric matrix. grom_decode_pgen_range() uses the direct range decoder used by the parallel PGEN loader. grom_decode_pgen_range_readlist() uses the legacy ReadList() path and is intended for regression testing.

Usage

grom_decode_pgen_range(
  pgen_file,
  raw_sample_ct,
  first_variant_1based,
  variant_count,
  sample_subset,
  meanimpute = TRUE,
  rounded_mean = FALSE,
  pgen_threads = 1L
)

grom_decode_pgen_range_readlist(
  pgen_file,
  raw_sample_ct,
  first_variant_1based,
  variant_count,
  sample_subset,
  meanimpute = TRUE,
  rounded_mean = FALSE
)

Arguments

pgen_file

Path to a PLINK2 .pgen file.

raw_sample_ct

Total number of samples in the PGEN file.

first_variant_1based

First variant to decode, using 1-based PGEN indexing.

variant_count

Number of contiguous variants to decode.

sample_subset

Optional strictly increasing 1-based sample subset. Use integer(0) for all samples.

meanimpute

Logical indicating whether missing dosages should be mean imputed.

rounded_mean

Logical indicating whether imputed means should be rounded.

pgen_threads

Number of independent PGEN loader threads requested by the direct range decoder.

Value

A numeric matrix with samples in rows and variants in columns.
